title: 受限条件下可到达节点的数目
summary: 无向树从节点零出发，禁止经过 restricted 中的节点，求可到达节点数量。
insight: 把受限节点预先标记，随后从零做 BFS，只把未受限且未访问的邻居加入队列。
pitfalls: 受限节点及其后方分支都不可达

solutions.title: 跳过受限节点的 BFS
solutions.idea: 在树上遍历零所在的可用连通分量。
steps: 建无向邻接表并标记 restricted
弹出节点计数，邻居未见且不受限时入队

code.java: class Solution { public int reachableNodes(int n,int[][] edges,int[] restricted){List<Integer>[] graph=new List[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)graph[i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].add(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].add(edge[0]);}boolean[] blocked=new boolean[n],seen=new boolean[n];for(int node:restricted)blocked[node]=true;Queue<Integer> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();queue.add(0);seen[0]=true;int answer=0;while(!queue.isEmpty()){int node=queue.poll();answer++;for(int next:graph[node])if(!seen[next]&&!blocked[next]){seen[next]=true;queue.add(next);}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun reachableNodes(n:Int,edges:Array<IntArray>,restricted:IntArray):Int{val graph=Array(n){mutableListOf<Int>()};for(edge in edges){graph[edge[0]].add(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].add(edge[0])};val blocked=BooleanArray(n);for(node in restricted)blocked[node]=true;val seen=BooleanArray(n);val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();queue.add(0);seen[0]=true;var answer=0;while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val node=queue.removeFirst();answer++;for(next in graph[node])if(!seen[next]&&!blocked[next]){seen[next]=true;queue.add(next)}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int reachableNodes(int n,vector<vector<int>>& edges,vector<int>& restricted){vector<vector<int>> graph(n);for(auto& edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].push_back(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].push_back(edge[0]);}vector<bool> blocked(n),seen(n);for(int node:restricted)blocked[node]=true;queue<int> pending;pending.push(0);seen[0]=true;int answer=0;while(!pending.empty()){int node=pending.front();pending.pop();++answer;for(int next:graph[node])if(!seen[next]&&!blocked[next]){seen[next]=true;pending.push(next);}}return answer;} };
